premises.text: Custom currency (gift cards, promo codes, refund credits) drives targeted marketing, but payment systems make tracking, controlling, and associating promotional value hard, so mid-size online merchants must build it themselves
premises.evidence_span: enabling custom currency is actually really hard to do

premises.text: GiftBit is a SaaS web app and API that lets businesses create, distribute, and manage their own custom currency integrated with checkout
premises.evidence_span: We have built a web application and a powerful API to enable a business to have, distribute, and manage their own custom currency

premises.text: Marketing teams can create timed promo codes, track redemptions, manage gift cards/refunds/promos in one admin, and re-engage lapsed gift-card holders with bonus promo value
premises.evidence_span: marketing teams get all the tools they need to be able to control, send, and track their custom currency

premises.text: Priced from $90/month for 1,000 active codes with Shopify Plus integration and Stripe/Braintree integrations in progress
premises.evidence_span: We've priced our product starting at $90 a month to make it accessible to businesses of any size
